say:1:1036009001:1.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to point my backside at you.
say:1:1036009001:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我不是故意拿屁股对着你。
say:1:1036009001:1.male: Sorry, I didn't mean to point my backside at you.
say:1:1036009001:1.female: Sorry, I didn't mean to point my backside at you.

say:2:1036009002:1.text: Just working on the best hiding position.
say:2:1036009002:1.source_cn: 我只是在研究一种最佳的藏匿姿势。

say:3:1036009003:1.text: The cave is full of those insane glimmerblooms! The only way to stay safe is to blend in and stay still!
say:3:1036009003:1.source_cn: 洞穴里全部都是发狂的荧荧花！只有藏得好，它们才不会发现你。
say:3:1036009003:1.male: The cave is full of those insane glimmerblooms! The only way to stay safe is to blend in and stay still!
say:3:1036009003:1.female: The cave is full of those insane glimmerblooms! The only way to stay safe is to blend in and stay still!

say:4:1036009004:1.text: Quick, tell me if I'm well hidden. Can you still see me?
say:4:1036009004:1.source_cn: 你快帮我看看，我刚才藏得怎么样？是不是发现不了？
say:4:1036009004:1.male: Quick, tell me if I'm well hidden. Can you still see me?
say:4:1036009004:1.female: Quick, tell me if I'm well hidden. Can you still see me?
